name: Financial Assistance To Ex-Convicts
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, the maximum amount of financial assistance is ₹15,000/- per person will be provided to the eligible beneficiary as one-time assistance.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicant should be Ex-Convict (released from jail from poor economic conditions).
1. The applicant should belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
